feedback.worked_solution:
| $x$ | **$0$** | **$1$** | **$2$** | **$3$** | **$4$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $y$ | $-3$ | $0$ | $4$ | $5$ | $8$ |

The coefficients of the line that best fits the data can be found as the least-squares solution $\overset{^}{\beta }$ to the system 

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{X}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 3 \\ 1 & 4\end{aligned}]}}\overset{\beta }{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{0} \\ {\beta }_{1}\end{aligned}]}} & =\overset{y}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 0 \\ 4 \\ 5 \\ 8\end{aligned}]}},\end{aligned}
$$

where $X$ is the design matrix, $\beta $ is the parameter vector, and $y$ is the observation vector.
